placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 25.500, v -2.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.682 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 2110 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2110 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '3B' printed on the 1911 sheet: 3 full storeys.

construction.note: The register reads the map's colours as 'brick with stone front'.

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35fp-2110-b1 p2 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 77% of its fill; s35fp-2110-b1 p1 (stone_front, stone), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 80% of its fill; s35fp-2110-b1 p3 (range, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 63% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'Romanesque' overlaid with the frontage row: The Harriet Rees house (Cobb & Frost, 1888) at its historical 2110 site, not its present one: the register's 'limestone front, tall gable' as a steep gable whose end faces the avenue over the 3B narrow body and its stone front, two bays wide. Its carved tympanum, loggia and bowed oriel are T-1922's and T-1923's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 4252346595 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
